## Summary

Tindall & Vane LLP: water damage from a burst pipe of two monitors and a desktop workstation at a client site in Kilburn. Covered under clause 4.7; reserve 4,806 dollars.

## Facts

Tindall & Vane LLP reported the loss on 13 June 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a client site in Kilburn [notice of loss]. The items are two monitors and a desktop workstation [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 15 June 2026 [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.7 of the policy, which covers damage from water escaping a fixed pipe [policy]. Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: no theft is alleged [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.7. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 4,806 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (3,074 dollars and 1,732 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]; the schedule applies no excess [policy].
